Container & model: `M` (three announcement channels and one banner row on a kernel-only boot, measured at the door), `mode:subagent`, `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Basis for the Clause-② line: it pulls the IPC message back to its documented contract. `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx:269`: "`objectstack:listening` | `os serve` | The HTTP server is bound. Carries `{ port, url }` — the port actually bound". A message announcing an address with nothing bound is outside that text. The state file has no documented contract (`serve.ts` calls it best-effort supervision), and the banner is human text. `serve.ts` is not reachable from `@objectstack/cli`'s `exports` beyond the `ServeCommand` default. No `packages/spec` edit.
Responsibility: `packages/cli`'s `os serve`, platform code in this lane | none: PR #23741 made only the banner's `API:` row read whether a transport is composed | an external supervisor that spawns `os serve --no-server` with an `ipc` channel and trusts `objectstack:listening`; no in-repo consumer is reached (`os dev` never spawns `--no-server`); half 2 needs a config that mounts its own `HonoServerPlugin`, with no in-repo producer (both measured by #23623's dev, report `6204307328`)
